title: Union Cabinet (chaired by PM Narendra Modi, Wed 11 Nov 2026) approves about ₹62,370 crore (₹62,370.02 crore, IANS) of nutrient-based subsidy on phosphatic and potassic (P&K) fertilisers, including DAP and NPKS grades, for Rabi 2026-27 (1 Oct 2026 to 31 Mar 2027) (PTI, IANS, Deccan Chronicle, Pragativadi); about 64% (₹24,417.73 crore) more than the ₹37,952.29 crore approved for Rabi 2025-26 on 28 Oct 2025 (IANS, ANI; 64.3% is idly's arithmetic). I&B Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw says fertiliser prices 'shot up immensely' because of the West Asia crisis and the Russia-Ukraine war, DAP stays at ₹1,350 per 50 kg bag, and calls the subsidy a 'shield to farmers from geopolitical turmoil' (PTI; Pragativadi). The subsidy is paid to fertiliser makers and importers at notified rates (IANS, Pragativadi).
